# Alliance Cable and Wire Harness

**Old description:** DESIGN, DEVELOPMENT, AND MANUFACTURING FOR ELECTRONICS INDUSTRY

## About
Alliance Cable & Wire Harness, headquartered in Lindon, Utah, was founded in 1936. The company operates as a boutique manufacturer of custom wire harnesses and cable assemblies, led by an executive team that includes President and CEO Cole Matson, Vice Presidents of Engineering Edd Todd and Sergio Martinez, and Board Advisor Chad London, who brings 35 years of industry experience.

The company provides end-to-end services from design and rapid prototyping through turnkey assembly, overmolding, kitting, drop shipping, and 100% functional testing. Its facility runs a high-mix, low-to-medium volume operation equipped with vertical injection molding machines, Komax cut-strip-crimp systems, ultrasonic splicers, automated solder lines, and in-house 3D printing for fixture development.

Alliance serves customers in oil and gas, robotics and sensors, solar photovoltaics, transportation, audio and video, electronics, instrumentation, and medical sectors. The firm notes long-standing relationships with Fortune 500 manufacturers and supplies businesses across the United States and Canada.

Differentiators cited by the company include vendor-managed inventory and consignment programs, quick-turn prototyping with stocked components, on-site design engineering, and after-market support that extends beyond a decade for obsolete products.

## Known for
- Vendor-managed inventory (VMI) and customer consignment programs
- Quick-turn prototyping with stocked wire and components
- On-site design engineering and manufacturing
- 100% functional and quality testing on every assembly
- After-market support for ten-plus years on legacy products

# Alloy Welding and Manufacturing Co., Inc.

**Old description:** We are a job shop with 85 years of experience in metal fabrication, placing the highest priority on quality workmanship and customer service.

## About
Alloy Welding and Manufacturing Co., Inc. was founded in 1937 by Delphis “Del” Frechette in Bristol, Connecticut. The company began as a job shop producing fabricated metal parts and welding repairs for local industry, with Del inventing and building much of his original equipment. After surviving the 1955 flood, the business relocated to its current 14,000-square-foot facility Now in its third generation under Darren Frechette, who took over in 2005, the company remains family-owned.

The shop provides metal fabrication, welding, and cutting services including GTAW, GMAW, and SMAW welding, CNC water jet cutting, hand-held laser welding, and portable on-site welding. It also offers metal sales and custom design with project management. The facility houses a CNC water jet and handheld laser welder for thin materials such as stainless steel and titanium, and operates mobile welding trucks for field repairs.

Customers span industrial manufacturers, military, construction, medical, and high-tech sectors, as well as schools, governments, hospitals, apartment complexes, general contractors, and individuals throughout central Connecticut.

The company emphasizes an ISO 9001:2015 quality system, OSHA-10 certified technicians, quick turnarounds, and a commitment to personal service — answering the phone directly and treating every person with respect.

## Known for
- ISO 9001:2015 quality system with OSHA-10 certified technicians
- Mobile welding trucks for on-site industrial maintenance and repairs
- CNC water jet and handheld laser welding for thin materials
- Third-generation family ownership with direct phone access
- Quick turnaround focus

**Old description:** Since our establishment in 2018, Alpine Consulting & Metal Works (ACMW) has been a trusted provider of custom metal fabrication, engineering solutions, and process consulting. Founded by Joseph Poulin, a seasoned professional with a BS in Mechanical Engineering Technology from the University of Maine at Orono, ACMW has built a reputation for delivering precision, innovation, and unmatched quality to a wide range of industries.

## About
Alpine Consulting & Metal Works was founded in 2018 by Joseph Poulin in Oakland, Maine. Poulin, a mechanical engineering technology graduate from the University of Maine at Orono, established the company to provide custom metal fabrication, engineering solutions, and process consulting.

The shop handles structural steel fabrication, welding (including FCAW), and industrial, mechanical, and pipe fabrication. Projects range from 500‑pound custom jobs to 4,000‑ton structural builds. In addition to fabrication, ACMW offers engineering support, project management, and fabrication‑software consulting for platforms such as Tekla PowerFab and STSX, with field‑engineering services available on‑site.

Customers include steel fabrication firms such as Cherokee Steel Inc. (Watertown, TN) and Ennis Steel (Ennis, TX), reflecting a focus on the structural and industrial steel sectors. The company serves a broad range of industries requiring custom metalwork and process optimization.

ACMW emphasizes a “can‑do” attitude and versatile solutions that span shop‑floor production, office‑based engineering, and field support. Its differentiation rests on combining hands‑on fabrication expertise with software‑driven process consulting to streamline clients’ workflows.

# Altek Electronics Inc (A Cyient DLM Company)

**Old description:** In addition to being the founder of Altek Company, a manufacturer of can testing equipment for the food and beverage industry under the name of Tech® Products, Steve is also the founder of Altek Electronics. Stephen graduated from UConn with a Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering, and earned a Master of Science degree in Electrical Engineering from Yale University. Earlier in his career, Mr. Altschuler was Vice President of Computer Dynamics (1963-72) and Manager of Quality Assurance for Adage Inc. (1959-63). He served on the Board of Trustees for the University of Connecticut from 1986-93 and is the former Director and Vice President of the Northwestern Connecticut Chamber of Commerce. In 1972 Steve established Altek, and for 50 years worked to create and maintain a business culture that emphasizes customer satisfaction. Stephen has worked successfully with his team to: create a loyal customer base; maintain a profitable business operation that pays its bills on time; and earn a solid reputation in the industry.

## About
Altek Electronics operates from Torrington, Connecticut, where Stephen Altschuler founded the company in 1972 after a career in quality assurance and computer systems. The business remained family-led for five decades — Altschuler’s son David now serves as CEO — before becoming part of Cyient DLM, a global electronics manufacturing services group.

The company provides full-spectrum electronics manufacturing services from its Connecticut facility, employing 130-plus people. Core processes include surface-mount and through-hole PCB assembly, BGA and leadless device placement, selective and wave soldering, conformal coating (with a PVA6000 system and IR2000 curing oven), wire and cable harness fabrication, box build and system integration, and functional test including high-voltage soldering. Engineering support covers design for manufacturability, component obsolescence management, and traceability.

Altek serves original equipment manufacturers in medical devices, aerospace, defense, telecommunications, industrial/commercial equipment, and transportation. The firm highlights its early adoption of AS9100 (certified to the “D” level in 2017) for aerospace work and ISO 13485 for medical assemblies, alongside IATF 16949 for automotive-related programs.

Altschuler established the company on a culture of customer satisfaction, on-time bill payment, and a reputation for reliability. Leadership states they aim to deliver the highest quality at the most competitive price without compromising core beliefs, emphasizing integrated box build to reduce hand-offs and early manufacturing involvement to avoid prototype-to-production pitfalls.

# Aluf Plastics

**Old description:** As a global manufacturer of compostable sealant, barrier sealant films, and laminates, we serve a diverse range of industries including food, beverage, medical, personal care, office, industrial, and other consumer packaged goods (CPG) segments.

## About
Earthfirst Films operates as a division of Aluf Plastics from its headquarters in Columbus, Ohio, with additional manufacturing sites in Orangeburg, New York, and Sulphur Springs, Texas. The business traces its roots to 1949 when Joe Tatem founded Plastic Suppliers as a privately held corporation in Blackwood, New Jersey. Over decades the company expanded through distribution and converting centers across the United States and Europe, beginning film manufacturing in Columbus in 1976. In 2022 the organization rebranded its biopolymer portfolio globally as Earthfirst®, and in 2025 it was acquired by API.

The Columbus campus houses two primary facilities: a blown film plant and a cast-and-tenter extrusion plant Core processes include blown film extrusion, cast and tenter extrusion, lamination, slitting, and converting. An on-site laboratory equipped with two lab extruders performs tensile, barrier, optical, FTIR, and microscopy testing. The company holds several patents on compostable sealant films and offers small-batch production with fast prototyping of laminates for brand owners.

Products target food, beverage, medical, personal care, office, industrial, and broader consumer packaged goods segments. Customers range from brand owners seeking compostable sealant and barrier sealant films to converters needing flow-wrap, shrink-sleeve, and laminated structures. The portfolio includes PLA-based films, PHA-based home-compostable grades, and other biobased polymers.

The company states its mission is to create sustainable solutions through open collaboration. Its differentiation rests on over 20 years of biopolymer extrusion experience, patented blown-extrusion technology for thin-gauge films, SQF-certified food-grade production at the blown film facility, and a commitment to rapid prototyping that acts as an incubator for new packaging ideas.

## Known for
- Patented blown extrusion process for biopolymer films
- Small-batch production and fast prototyping of laminates
- Home compostable solutions including PHA grades
- SQF certified blown film facility for food-grade packaging
- Over 20 years of biopolymer film extrusion expertise

## Capabilities

- Small batch production

# Amark Wire

**Old description:** For over 50 years, Amark Wire has been a recognized leader in the custom manufacturing of wires, pins, and cables. We specialize in smaller, more difficult products that are used across many different industries and in some of the most critical applications.

## About
Amark Wire, based in Fairfield, New Jersey, has spent over 50 years as a custom manufacturer of wires, pins, and cables. The company focuses on smaller, more difficult products that serve a wide range of industries and critical applications.

The shop specializes in drawing, grinding, straightening, cutting, forming, and spooling small-diameter wire rod from 0.002″ to 0.250″ in diameter and up to 12 feet in length. Its process lineup includes Escomatic Swiss screw machining, four-slide machining, centerless grinding, wire EDM, flattening, heading, precision bending, sand blasting, tumbling, upsetting, wire threading, cold forming, and spooling. Output ranges from conductors and drawn wire to electrical pins, electrodes, eyelets, hermetically sealed pins, guide wires, hinge pins, inserts, micro welding wire, rods, shafts, springs, step pins, studs, stylets, thermocouple wire, and tubing. All materials and products are manufactured in the United States, and the company works with a broad palette of metals including rare precious alloys.

Amark Wire serves automotive, aerospace, defense, dental, earth sciences, electrical, environmental sciences, fiber optics, glass sealing, and medical sectors. Defense and medical applications are highlighted as key markets.

The company emphasizes fast turnaround times, competitive pricing, and the ability to work with any material, including rare precious metals. It maintains original material certifications and test reports on file, offers sample parts, and treats customer schematics as confidential.

## Known for
- Fastest turnaround times in the industry
- Competitive pricing on high-quality products
- All products manufactured in the USA
- Close tolerances on diameters from 0.002″ to 0.250″
- Works with any material, including rare precious metals

# American Alloy Fabrication Inc

**Old description:** American Alloy Fabrication, Inc. (AAFI) has been serving customers with metal fabricated components for more than 35 years. Our success is a result of our continued investment in the latest manufacturing technologies as well as our aggressive focus on quality, lean manufacturing principles and continuous improvement.

## About
American Alloy Fabrication, Inc. (AAFI) was founded in 1980 in Huntsville, Alabama, as a one-man shop offering precision welding services to local industries. The company incorporated in 1987 and moved into its current facility, which has since been expanded multiple times to accommodate growth.

Today AAFI operates as a full-service, vertically integrated contract manufacturer producing fabricated parts, industrial enclosures, custom weldments, and mechanical assemblies. Its capabilities span laser cutting, CNC turret punching, CNC forming, CNC and manual machining, robotic and manual welding (MIG, TIG, spot), metal finishing, deburring, polishing, mechanical assembly, and packaging and logistics support. The facility is equipped with advanced inspection tools including coordinate measuring machines, optical comparators, and laser scanners, and the company emphasizes design-for-manufacturability support, prototype development, and production manufacturing.

The customer base extends across diverse industries, beginning with a local engine manufacturer in the 1980s that commissioned reusable shipping racks. That project launched AAFI into large-scale contract manufacturing, and the company now serves a range of industrial sectors requiring precision metal fabrication.

AAFI differentiates itself through a quality management system that consistently achieves above 95% acceptance and on-time delivery ratings, a commitment to continuous improvement, and a partnership model that aims to function as an extension of the customer’s organization. The company states its focus on precision, high-tolerance products and long-term relationships as core to its approach.

# American Auto Parts

**Old description:** Dan has been with American Auto Parts since 2001. For the past 15 years Dan has experienced all facets of the Parts sales side of the business from Outside sales to Management and so on. Dan specializes in Part sales and Service. Dan has over 35 years of extensive experience in Auto, Light Truck, Foreign and Domestic parts from drive train to chassis and suspension. Dan wants everyone to know he is ready to serve.

## About
American Auto Parts operates from a 100,000-square-foot facility on five acres in Omaha, Nebraska. The company has served the greater Omaha area for over 50 years, though a precise founding year is not publicly stated. Ownership details are not disclosed; the business is known through long-tenured staff such as Dan, who joined in 2001 and brings 35 years of industry experience, and Mark, with the company since 2000.

The company supplies domestic and foreign used, remanufactured, aftermarket, and new OEM surplus auto parts. Its inventory spans engines, transmissions, car doors, radiators, differentials, transfer cases, tires, and wheels. Operations include a parts locating service, coast-to-coast shipping (airbags excluded), local delivery, and 24/7 online ordering through an eBay storefront. The facility’s extensive space supports a large on-hand inventory.

Customers include fellow automotive recyclers, independent garages, body shops, and individual vehicle owners. The company ships used and remanufactured parts to any destination in the continental United States, serving both trade and retail buyers.

American Auto Parts highlights its large inventory and facility size as key to maintaining stock availability, and describes its delivery service as unmatched in the market.

- 100,000+ sq ft facility on 5+ acres
- 50+ years serving the Omaha area
- Coast-to-coast shipping of used/remanufactured parts (airbags excluded)
- 24/7 online inventory access via eBay
- Fast parts techs and unbeatable delivery service

# American Bean

**Old description:** Believe in better results with American Bean. We are a company founded on the principle that quality products mean increased yields and higher profitability for our customers, growers, and buyers alike. From the farm to the fork, our products are held to a higher standard through each step of our process to ensure the highest quality and value driven results with every bean.

## About
American Bean is headquartered in Petersburg, North Dakota, with additional facilities in Angus and Oslo, Minnesota, and Sharon, North Dakota. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or the names of its founders.

The company specializes in producing and supplying dry bean certified seed, with a portfolio that includes pinto and cranberry varieties. It works with a network of growers who adhere to rigorous production standards, and it manages seed selection, conditioning, and packaging. American Bean also operates a food safety program that has been audited and certified under the Primus GFS standard, a Global Food Safety Initiative benchmark.

Its customers include both growers who produce seed under contract and buyers worldwide who source certified dry bean seed for commercial production. The company serves the agricultural seed sector and the broader food processing industry, providing crop price information and recipes alongside its seed products.

American Bean was founded on the principle that quality products lead to increased yields and higher profitability for growers and buyers alike. It emphasizes a farm-to-fork quality standard and highlights its Primus GFS certification as evidence of its commitment to safe, superior food products.

## Known for
- Quality products linked to increased yields and profitability
- Farm-to-fork quality standard across all process steps
- Primus GFS certified food safety program
- Wide variety of certified dry bean seeds (pinto, cranberry, others)
- Grower network held to rigorous production standards

- Certified dry bean seed production
- Seed selection and conditioning
